title: Slo Mocean Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Modern new construction home located directly across from the beach in Seaside at East Ruskin Pavilion. Incredible designer touches throughout and a rooftop deck on the second floor with incredible Seaside town views, Gulf views, and sunsets!
description_expanded: Description12 EAST RUSKIN STREET4 KINGS, 2 BUNK BEDS, 1 XL TWIN DAYBED - (Sleeps 13) A Grand Coastal Home for Multi-Generational Gatherings in Seaside, FloridaDirectly across from the beach at East Ruskin Pavilion in the heart of Seaside, Slo Mocean is a refined coastal retreat designed for elevated group travel. Thoughtfully crafted for multi-family stays and celebratory gatherings, this newer luxury residence pairs timeless Seaside architecture with curated interiors, expansive living spaces, and effortless access to the Gulf.From arrival, the experience is unmistakably welcoming layered in comfort, elevated in design, and ideally positioned just steps from the sand and moments from the vibrant heart of town.Inviting Outdoor Living & Seamless Indoor FlowA gracious front porch overlooks iconic Highway 30A, complete with four chaise loungers set amid lush landscaping—an inviting perch for morning coffee or sunset conversations. After a day at the beach, an enclosed outdoor shower with multiple spa-style rain heads offers a refreshing, resort-worthy rinse.Inside, a dedicated mudroom and laundry suite with stand-alone ice maker, full-size washer and dryer, and custom built-in storage lockers keeps beach days beautifully organized. A secondary side porch overlooking charming East Ruskin Street provides yet another intimate space for relaxed gatherings and coastal breezes.First Floor | Three Private King Suites & Secondary LivingThe main level is thoughtfully designed for privacy and flexibility, offering three beautifully appointed king suites—each with its own en-suite bath. Ideal for multiple families traveling together, this level also includes a private secondary living room with plush seating, mounted flat-screen television, and Sonos soundbar—perfect for movie nights, game days, or giving teens and grandparents their own retreat.Each king suite is distinct yet equally refined, featuring custom furnishings and marble-finished baths with glass-enclosed showers or tub/shower combinations. The primary king suite on this level offers dual marble vanities and a spa-inspired shower with dual rain heads for a truly indulgent experience. The second and third kings down each offer ensuite marble bathrooms, large dressers, and a mounted flat screen TV in every bedroom down.Second Floor | Grand Living, Dining & Chef’s KitchenAscend the stunning wood staircase to the home’s central gathering level. A half bath is conveniently located on the landing before entering the expansive primary living space. Upstairs, two curved designer sectionals, club chairs, and a large ottoman create a sophisticated yet inviting setting around a grand flat-screen TV with Sonos soundbar. Just beyond, outdoor dining for six and a bright conversation area with signature orange rocking chairs extend the living space outdoors.At the heart of the home, the chef’s kitchen and dining room are designed for connection and celebration. A statement dining table comfortably seats twelve, while the quartzite island offers additional seating for four. Outfitted with a Wolf cooktop, oversized built-in refrigerator, custom cabinetry, and premium cookware, the kitchen balances professional performance with coastal elegance. A charming Juliet balcony adds natural light and architectural character.This level also hosts two additional bedrooms:Primary King Suite – A serene retreat with refined furnishings, private TV, and a spa-style bath featuring dual marble vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with dual rain heads.Custom Bunk Suite – Designed with four built-in twin bunks, individual reading lights, shelving, and mounted TV, plus a private bath with dual vanities and glass-enclosed shower—an ideal haven for children and teens. Third Floor | Tower Loft & Gulf-View Rooftop DeckThe third-floor tower is accessible via full width easy access stairs and the bonus living area loft offers an enclosed indoor escape with sofa seating and mounted TV—perfect for quiet mornings or evening films. The tower includes an XL twin daybed to accommodate one more stow away sleeping 13 in all! Step outside to the open-air rooftop deck, where two chaise loungers frame adjacent sweeping Gulf views and unforgettable sunsets over the Gulf of Mexico and the town of Seaside. This elevated vantage point captures the coastal breeze and the timeless beauty of this iconic beach town.Optional Detached Guest Cottage | SeasuiteFor those seeking additional privacy, Slo Mocean offers the option to include Seasuite, a charming detached guest cottage just steps from the main home.The cottage features:Queen bedroom and full bath on the first floorUpstairs sitting area with kitchenette and glass tile inlaid countertopsIn-unit washer and dryerIdeal for grandparents, couples, or extended family, Seasuite adds flexibility while maintaining proximity to the main gathering spaces.An Elevated Seaside ExperienceWith multiple living areas, five bedrooms plus optional cottage, thoughtfully curated outdoor spaces, and an unrivaled location directly across from the beach, Slo Mocean offers a rare combination of luxury, comfort, and connection. This grand home is designed for multi-generational stays and unforgettable celebrations, this is coastal living at its most refined—steps from the sand and moments from the best of Seaside.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer; 3-night minimum for Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURES3,593 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space1-minute walk (59 feet) to private residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion; the largest private residential beaches on 30AFour king bedrooms, ideal for families and groupsDigital streaming TVs in all bedrooms (no cable)Sonos Sound bars Freestanding ice maker for easy beach days and gatheringsWasher and dryer are conveniently located in the homePrivate off street parking in Driveway for one car, plus two parking passesPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002087
